resolve_merge_request_thread.description: Resolve a thread on a merge request. Use this to mark an existing merge request review thread resolved; use `update_merge_request_discussion_note` when the note text itself must change. The operation changes review state, requires permission to resolve discussions, and returns the updated discussion or a missing-thread/permission error.

merge_request_iid.description: The IID of a merge request

project_id.description: Project ID or complete URL-encoded path to project
